items.description: Upgrade to premium carbon frame (elective, bicycle recovered undamaged)
items.rationale: Policy 3.1.6, 7.1.8(c): The frame upgrade is an elective improvement, not caused by the insured event. The recovered bicycle was undamaged, so no indemnity for upgrades or replacements by policyholder's choice.

items.description: Brake replacement as part of routine service
items.rationale: Policy 3.1.6, 7.1.8(a): Routine service and replacement of undamaged parts is not indemnified. No damage to brakes from the theft event.
Policy 3.1.6, 7.1.8(a): General servicing and tune-up is maintenance, not repair of insured damage. Not indemnified.
Policy 7.1.8(f): Ancillary charges are only indemnified if the main work is covered. Here, all main work is excluded, so shipping is not indemnified.
Policy 7.1.8(f): Ancillary charges are only indemnified if the main work is covered. Here, all main work is excluded, so vehicle costs are not indemnified.
Policy 7.1.8(a): Assembly for elective upgrades or maintenance is not indemnified. No insured damage to repair.
Policy 7.1.8(a): Labour for non-indemnifiable work (maintenance, elective upgrades) is not covered.
Policy 7.1.8(a): Labour for non-indemnifiable work (maintenance, elective upgrades) is not covered.

Policy 5.2.2(b), 7.1.7: Recovery costs for attendance at the site to release the recovered bicycle are covered, subject to the mobility equipment sub-limit (EUR 500/event, aggregate). Reference Case 24 supports indemnity for this head.

items.description: Cut and remove seized lock to release bicycle
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.2(b): Cutting and removing the lock to recover the bicycle is a covered recovery cost, subject to the mobility equipment sub-limit (EUR 500/event, aggregate). Reference Case 24 supports indemnity for this head.

Policy 5.2.2(b), 7.1.7(d): Labour for the locksmith's recovery work is covered, subject to the mobility equipment sub-limit (EUR 500/event, aggregate). Reference Case 24 supports indemnity for this head.
